data.name: SecretCommand.Description
data.value: Hosts commands for generating and verifying verification codes. Use this command to change the verification code provider, for example: services.get secret | secret

data.name: SecretGenerateCommand.Description
data.value: Generates one or more verification codes, for example: secret.generate -name:'user.phone.change:100' -pattern:#4 -timeout:15m 13800000001 13800000002 13800000003

data.name: SecretGenerateCommand.Options.Name
data.value: The verification code name, usually including the target identifier, for example: user.forget:100 or user.email:100, where 100 is the user's unique identifier.

data.name: SecretGenerateCommand.Options.Pattern
data.value: The verification code generation pattern. If omitted or empty, a six-digit code is generated. Supported patterns: - guid|uuid: generates a GUID value - #{number}: generates {number} digits, for example: #4 - ?{number}: generates {number} alphanumeric characters, for example: ?8

data.name: SecretVerifyCommand.Description

data.name: SecretVerifyCommand.Options.Name
data.value: The verification code name, usually including the target identifier, for example: user.forget:100 or user.email:100, where 100 is the user's unique identifier.

data.name: ServicesGetCommand.Description
data.value:
Retrieves service objects from the current service provider and displays their information.
Usage:
services.get <service-name> The argument is the name under which the service is registered with the current service provider.
services.get -contract:assemblyQualifiedName The -contract option specifies the assembly-qualified service type name.
services.get -contract:assemblyQualifiedName parameter The -contract option specifies the assembly-qualified service type name; the argument is passed to the resolver.
